entities.name: Sheoldred
entities.description: Praetor of the Black Faction of New Phyrexia who led the invasion of Dominaria, lost a power struggle against Elesh Norn, and was beheaded by Ajani.

entities.name: New Phyrexia
entities.description: The Phyrexianised Mirrodin ruled by the praetors.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: The plane Sheoldred invaded in 4562 AR.

entities.name: Elesh Norn
entities.description: The Mother of Machines, a praetor who defeats Sheoldred and orders her decapitated.

entities.name: Ajani Goldmane
entities.description: A planeswalker compleated by Sheoldred who captures and beheads her on Norn's orders.

entities.name: Black Faction
entities.description: The black faction of New Phyrexia led by Sheoldred, whose goal was to enslave.

entities.name: Seven Steel Thanes
entities.description: Warlords of the Black faction on Phyrexianised Mirrodin, each intending to take over the plane.

entities.name: Geth
entities.description: A thane in direct competition with Sheoldred who later joins Urabrask's rebellion.

entities.name: Roxith
entities.description: A thane who failed to access one of Sheoldred's coffers and was killed.

entities.name: Vraan
entities.description: A thane who joins Urabrask's rebellion.

entities.name: Urabrask
entities.description: A praetor whose rebellion against Elesh Norn Sheoldred joins.

entities.name: Dross Pits
entities.description: Sheoldred's territory on New Phyrexia, where she ran a grand coliseum.

entities.name: Caves of Koilos
entities.description: Where Sheoldred arrived on Dominaria and was rebuilt.

entities.name: Rona
entities.description: Member of the Society of Mishra who discovered and rebuilt Sheoldred.

entities.name: Society of Mishra
entities.description: The group that rebuilt Sheoldred on Dominaria.

entities.name: Ertai
entities.description: A character resurrected by Sheoldred.

entities.name: Karn
entities.description: Captured by Sheoldred at the Battle of the Mana Rig and returned to New Phyrexia.

entities.name: Battle of the Mana Rig
entities.description: Battle that Sheoldred led while affixed to a dragon engine.

entities.name: Tezzeret
entities.description: Carried Sheoldred back to her lair in the Dross Pits.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The Phyrexian invasion of the multiverse launched by Elesh Norn.

events.summary: Sheoldred earns her praetor position by manipulating the other thanes against each other.
events.quote: She earned her praetor position by manipulating the other thanes against each other.

events.summary: Sheoldred outsmarts Roxith, who is killed when he fails to access one of her coffers, and establishes her territory in the Dross Pits.
events.quote: She outsmarted Roxith when he failed to access one of her coffers and was killed.

events.summary: Elesh Norn lays waste to Sheoldred's domain, and Sheoldred then serves Norn in the multiversal invasions.
events.quote: Ultimately, Elesh Norn laid waste to her domain.

events.summary: Sheoldred arrives in the Caves of Koilos on Dominaria, recuperates, and is rebuilt by Rona and the Society of Mishra.
events.quote: was discovered and rebuilt by Rona and the Society of Mishra

events.summary: Sheoldred mass-produces sleeper agents, resurrects Ertai, and compleats Ajani Goldmane.
events.quote: resurrected Ertai , and compleated the planeswalker Ajani Goldmane

events.summary: Sheoldred leads the attack at the Battle of the Mana Rig on a dragon engine and captures Karn.
events.quote: captured Karn , returning him to New Phyrexia

events.summary: Tezzeret carries Sheoldred back to her lair in the Dross Pits.
events.quote: Tezzeret carried Sheoldred back to her lair in the Dross Pits.

events.summary: Sheoldred moves against Elesh Norn and allies with Urabrask's rebellion; Norn declares her an apostate and Ajani captures her.
events.quote: Norn declared her an apostate, and she was later captured by Ajani.

events.summary: Brought before Norn, Sheoldred is decapitated by Ajani with his axe, the first known death of a New Phyrexian praetor.
events.quote: ordered Ajani to decapitate her with his axe

relations.quote: The black-aligned faction, led by Sheoldred, had one goal: enslave.

relations.note: She was part of this affiliation as well as being a praetor.
relations.quote: known as the Seven Steel Thanes

relations.note: Powerful rival who lost a power struggle to Norn.
relations.quote: Sheoldred remained a powerful rival to Norn
He obliged Norn's wish, resulting in the first known death of a New Phyrexian praetor.
ordered Ajani to decapitate her with his axe
